entries.notes: Repair, not a rewrite. Sentence 1 replaces the old 25x clause (now a SpecCard of its own) with the only thing the merged block gained: which of the two names each number was measured on — docs/01-proof-bank.md §E2, three rows PAPAYA FLEX, one row PAPAYA. Symmetric on purpose: `lấy trên … / của … ở …` reports provenance and implies nothing about how the two parts relate, which the proof bank does not carry (open_decisions/papaya-pair-relationship). No claim is cited because none can be: C005, C034 and C007 all require their counterparty in the same string, and naming three counterparties here would duplicate the strip 40px below. Sentence 2 survives from the approved pass, minus `thì GPU vẫn đúng` → `vẫn cần GPU`. 32 words, 2 sentences, first sentence 17 — length_budget/product_body. Second pass: `còn PAPAYA` replaces `của PAPAYA` — with the ellipsis alone the second name reads as an abbreviation of the first, which would hand the ~10.000× figure to PAPAYA FLEX. `còn X` marks a new topic and cannot be read as apposition. 32 words, first sentence 17.
